open_issues.text: The documented client path is broken in code. The hub (readClientProtocol in hub/src/index.js) makes every connection without ?protocol=2 read-only, and neither @vaulter/vue-collaboration (transport.ts builds HocuspocusProvider without parameters) nor the PHP session url adds it, so a real browser editor never saves. The docs state the requirement openly: a warning box in guides/collaboration.md (EN and RU), the troubleshooting list, the vue-collaboration README and the CHANGELOG, with the createHocuspocusProvider override as the workaround. I did not touch code.
